title: Radio Button
text: Select parameter value, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Enumerated Data Type} sets the state values and labels using an enumerated data, {Group Name} sets the radio Button group, {States} sets the of states to select for connected parameter scalar and character, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color and {Background Color} sets the block background color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Enumerated Data Type
params.values: Specify state values and labels using an enumerated data type off (default) | on

params.name: Group Name
params.values: Radio Button group name RadioButtonGroup (default) | character vector

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide

params.name: States
params.values: Set of states to select for connected parameter scalar and character vector

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector
